claim_boundary.role: previously opened difficult development sentinel; not an unbiased confirmatory scene

known_posthoc_source_only_feasibility.scientific_status: exploratory diagnosis; not a preregistered or unbiased result
known_posthoc_source_only_feasibility.fixed_map_tested_once: exact-reference-weighted right-continuous empirical CDF fitted separately on each fold's training-source scores

claim_boundary.permitted_claim: A source-only rank gauge removes most fold-specific absolute-score drift on this opened Lego diagnostic; any subsequent target result remains development evidence.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claim: The posthoc OOF feasibility numbers are confirmatory evidence or an unbiased benchmark result.

full_fit_pre_metric_prediction_receipt.use: immutable raw t_seen=0.71 and sealed continuous target-score paths only after the full-fit source gauge is sealed

rank_gauge_contract.fold_training_population: rows whose exact training_reference_weight is positive
rank_gauge_contract.full_fit_population: rows whose immutable complete-source reference_weight is positive
rank_gauge_contract.weight: the corresponding exact reference responsibility weight
rank_gauge_contract.tie_semantics: right-continuous; all source mass exactly equal to s is included

completion_contract.threshold_grid: 0.99,0.98,...,0.03 descending in the OOF quantile gauge
completion_contract.tie_break: strict improvement retains the first descending threshold
completion_contract.selection: one pooled threshold maximizing responsibility-weighted soft IoU on exactly the three held-out observed populations
completion_contract.fold_stability: report per-fold optima and require max-minus-min <= 0.10
completion_contract.frozen_after_known_feasibility: t_completion_quantile=0.96; it may not be changed after full-fit or target access

full_fit_and_prediction_contract.full_fit_support: run the same frozen K201 interface once using complete invariant source positive/reference evidence and no heldout clearing
full_fit_and_prediction_contract.full_fit_cdf: fit the fixed weighted right-ECDF only to full-fit primitive scores with complete-source reference weights
full_fit_and_prediction_contract.t_seen: map the sealed raw 0.71 threshold through the same full-fit source CDF
full_fit_and_prediction_contract.target_score: map each already sealed continuous target score through the same full-fit source CDF; target values do not alter the CDF
full_fit_and_prediction_contract.source_visibility: unchanged v1 query-independent source-visible definition and rendering

stop_rules: Fail closed unless the three input fold files and all tensor authorities match their frozen hashes.
Stop if the independently implemented CPU authority does not reproduce thresholds 0.95,0.99,0.93, span 0.06, and pooled threshold 0.96.
Stop before target prediction unless the full-fit support and source-only ECDF are sealed with tensor hashes.
Do not change CDF definition, weight, ties, K, bandwidth, cap, threshold grid, visibility rule, interpolation, or threshold after any target access.
forbidden: overwriting or extending any stopped v1 output
target RGB, target foundation features, masks, or metrics as calibration inputs
target-score histogram matching or target-distribution normalization
CDF smoothing, temperature, cap, bandwidth, interpolation-weight, threshold-family, or scene-specific scans

execution.expected_gpu_work: one fixed Lego K201 full-fit support, approximately 10-25 seconds on one GPU
